events.action: {"message": "Fixed the off-by-three boundary check defect in `/zephyrproject/zephyr/drivers/eeprom/eeprom_simulator.c` (`eeprom_range_is_valid`), changing `(offset + len) <= config->size + 3` to `(offset + len) <= config->size`. Previously, out-of-bounds reads/writes up to 3 bytes past the end of the EEPROM buffer bypassed validation and caused a segmentation fault when writing beyond the memory-mapped region.\n\nVerified by building and running `tests/drivers/eeprom/api` on `native_sim`, with all tests passing (`PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL`).", "kind": "FinishAction"}
